name: 产品合规性文档制作 (7DO)
description_en_html:
Overview

Products might pose risks throughout the value chain that many industries handle by creating structured communication documents (often regulated by law). This scope item covers the main process steps for generating product-compliance-relevant documents, using the structure of a safety data sheet as an example.

To create product compliance documents, you may need to gather a large amount of data that must be systematically structured and assessed. To facilitate this, a work view provides you with easy access to both compliance requirements and apps for entering relevant properties. You can efficiently control document output by adapting the template structure to your needs.

Key Process Flow

  • Link a safety data sheet template to the relevant compliance requirement version for safety data sheet management

  • Create a chemical composition for the mixture on the level of an unpackaged product

  • Create identifiers for the product that can be used in documents, such as safety data sheet and labels

  • Use the work view for easy access to relevant apps for managing product’s properties, such as safety-related properties, physical-chemical properties, and toxicological information

  • Use compliance requirements and assessments to enter and update regulatory data, such as GHS classification or hazardous ingredients

  • Generate a base safety data sheet and release the safety data sheet assessment

Business Benefits

  • Mitigate compliance risks by keeping the compliance data up to date

  • Have unified compliance data that enables coherent compliance processes

  • Integrate data from different solution capabilities, such as Dangerous Goods Management and Product Marketability and Chemical Compliance, and print it in one document
description_zh_html:
概览

产品可能会在整个价值链中带来风险，许多行业都通过创建结构化通信文档（通常受法律监管）来处理这些风险。此范围项目涵盖生成产品合规性相关文档的主要流程步骤，以安全技术说明书的结构为例。

要创建产品合规性文档，您可能需要收集大量必须进行系统构建和评估的数据。为此，可通过工作视图轻松访问合规性要求和用于输入相关属性的应用。您可以根据需要调整模板结构，从而有效地控制文档输出。

关键流程流

  • 将安全技术说明书模板链接到安全技术说明书管理的相关合规性要求版本。

  • 在无包装产品级别为混合物创建化学成分。

  • 为可在文档中使用的产品创建标识符，例如安全技术说明书和标签

  • 使用工作视图轻松访问用于管理产品性质的相关应用，例如安全相关性质、物理化学性质和毒理学信息

  • 使用合规性要求和评估来输入和更新法规数据，例如 GHS 分类或有害成分

  • 生成基本安全技术说明书，并发布安全技术说明书评估

业务优势

  • 通过保持合规性数据的最新来降低合规性风险。

  • 拥有统一的合规性数据，以实现连贯的合规性流程

  • 集成来自不同解决方案功能的数据，例如危险品管理和产品适销性和化学品合规性，并将其打印在一个文档中
